result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 3 Article 12 Division 1 on hospitality-employer minimum wage enforcement, then Chapter 4 on health and sanitation permits), retrieved from a page titled as the algorithmic rent-pricing prohibition but containing no rental housing rules.
result.notes: This part contains only hospitality-worker minimum wage provisions (§§ 312.0107-312.0112) and health permit provisions (Ch. 4, §§ 41.00-41.35). None address rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, application screening fees, screening restrictions or algorithmic rent setting. The page URL and title refer to a San Diego prohibition on algorithmic rent-price fixing (Division 11, § 98.1103), but its text is not included in this excerpt, so no rule is extracted.
